articles.title: Berlin approves $930 million in arms sales to Israel
articles.summary: Germany approved nearly €800 million in arms exports to Israel between January and June, Der Spiegel reported, citing government documents. This substantial military backing highlights the ongoing defence cooperation and strategic relationship between the two nations, showcasing Germany's role in supporting Israel amidst current geopolitical circumstances and bilateral foreign policy.

articles.title: Cincinnati Reds: Elly De La Cruz progressing through quad injury, looking to finish strong
articles.summary: Cincinnati Reds shortstop Elly De La Cruz suffered a minor left quad strain but continued playing against the San Diego Padres as a designated hitter. This strategic move allowed him to remain in the lineup, managing his injury while contributing to the team's performance throughout the series. It showcases player determination amidst physical challenges.

articles.title: Canada-U.S. trade war complicates Hydro plan to purchase gas turbines from U.S. manufacturer
articles.summary: The Canada-U.S. trade war is complicating Manitoba Hydro's $3-billion Brandon generating station expansion. The company's plan to purchase essential gas turbines from a Massachusetts-based manufacturer is now hindered due to these trade tensions. This situation highlights how international trade disputes can significantly impact large-scale national infrastructure projects and procurement processes for vital equipment.
